verses.text: For the music director. To the tune "Silent Dove in Distant Lands." A poem of David, written when the Philistines captured him in Gath. God, be kind to me, because people are trying to swallow me up. All day long they attack and crush me.
My enemies try to swallow me up all day long. So many people proudly fight against me.
When I am afraid, I will trust in you.
I praise God for what he has promised. I trust in God, so I will not be afraid. What can mere humans do to me?
All day long they twist my words. They are always planning to hurt me.
They plot together and hide. They watch my every step, eager to kill me.
Will they get away with their evil? God, bring the nations down in your anger.
You keep track of all my wandering. You have collected all my tears in your bottle. Haven't you written them in your book?
My enemies will turn back on the day I call for help. This I know: God is on my side.
I praise God for what he has promised. I praise the LORD for what he has promised.
I trust in God, so I will not be afraid. What can people do to me?
God, I will keep the promises I made to you. I will give you offerings of thanks.
You have rescued me from death and kept my feet from tripping, so I can walk with God in the light of life.
